da-lean-narrative-divergence.referee_argument: .md:7-14 lists (C1) QOU.QPochhammer.ArchimedeanLimit as a uniqueness hypothesis and .md:51-54 'takes both classes as [Instance] hypotheses'; but .lean:113-120 archimedean_functor_uniqueness (D τ_arch : ℝ→ℝ) [hD:BlochSuslinUniqueness D] (h_cont)(h_anti)(h_pent) — ArchimedeanLimit absent from the signature.
da-lean-narrative-divergence.rebuttal: partial→survived — the Lean is honest and non-vacuous (:= hD.uniqueness τ_arch h_cont h_anti h_pent genuinely composes the field with three hypotheses, not a self-projection), and ArchimedeanLimit enters only at the scalar-fixing figure8_calibration step; but the §3b-cond banner is overstated (only one class gates uniqueness).

da-overclaim.referee_argument: .md:31-36 claims D unique 'on ℂ∖{0,1}' with the complex D(z)=Im Li_2(z)+log|z|arg(1-z); .lean:51,70,84 work entirely over ℝ→ℝ with antisymmetry degraded to D(x^-1)=-D(x); the complex uniqueness that pins hyperbolic volume is not formalised.
da-overclaim.rebuttal: partial→survived — self-flagged in the docstring (not hidden), the real-slice statement is a legitimate weaker lemma, and Im(q_0)=0 wall requires real observable evaluation (regime-consistent); but the prose claims a strictly stronger complex result than the Lean delivers.

da-citation-misuse.referee_argument: .md:15-18,152-159 attribute to Suslin1991 'any continuous antisymmetric pentagon-coherent real-valued function is c·D'; Suslin 1991 proves rigidity of K_3^ind / uniqueness of the regulator up to scalar, the clean pointwise statement is closer to Bloch/Zagier.
da-citation-misuse.rebuttal: partial — bloch2000 + zagier1986 are co-cited and do support the dilog characterisation; the block is explicitly conditional and lists the K-theory gap as open, so not asserting the hypothesis as proved; but the Suslin attribution is a paraphrase not verbatim.

da-definitional-ambiguity.referee_argument: 'the unique archimedean functor' could smuggle a hidden DOF (normalization).
da-definitional-ambiguity.rebuttal: rebutted — block is explicit uniqueness is only 'up to a single multiplicative real scalar' (.md:20-21), and that scalar is separately fixed by Faddeev-Kashaev in figure8_calibration (c=1). The one real DOF is named and pinned, not hidden.

da-reproducibility.referee_argument: .ts:7-12 wires witness q-pinning-50-digit.witness.json status:verified; .md:229-231 correctly says 'No numerical witness is appropriate for a uniqueness claim'.
da-reproducibility.rebuttal: partial — the prose is honest that no witness backs the claim; the .ts link is a loose provenance pointer to the substrate q_0, not a uniqueness proof (cosmetic mismatch).

da-referee-verdict.referee_argument: The .md advertises conditional uniqueness axiomatising BOTH named classes per §3b-cond, but the Lean theorem takes only BlochSuslinUniqueness and re-proves uniqueness over ℝ→ℝ, whereas the narrative's uniqueness lives on the complex Bloch-Wigner D on ℂ∖{0,1} — so the Lean proves a strictly weaker (real-slice) statement and ArchimedeanLimit never appears as a hypothesis.
